scope: Read-only index of upstream pick-and-place sources (grasp candidates, perception, target tracking, IK/reachability/collision/motion, held-object motion, placement candidates and verification, scripted experts, learned policies, primitive libraries and recipes). Entries are discovery records, not Hub bundles: every entry has invocable_in_hub=false and is never loaded by search, view, lock or runtime. Merged from 12 collection shards (2026-11-08); each entry pins a full commit and a concrete source file whose sha256 is in evidence.
counting_policy: One distinct entry per dedup_key (case-insensitive) and per repository + entrypoint file + capability. Different capabilities of one project are separate entries; object, colour, direction, robot-model and parameter variants are merged; mirrors and forks are merged into the original repository; environment-only task definitions are folded into the generator that produces their demonstrations. Counts must be reported separately for each license status (permissive / copyleft / research-only / unresolved) and for each review level (metadata-indexed vs implementation-inspected); never sum them into a single 'usable' total. A code license label does not clear weights, datasets or dependencies. No entry is invocable; a capability claim here is not a YAM-verified skill.

entries.name: HomeRobot HeuristicPlacePolicy (receptacle slab sampling + desnap)

entries.name: Ravens discrete oracle: pick-pixel / place-pose selection
entries.summary: Task._discrete_oracle matches unplaced objects to goal targets (farthest-from-nearest-target first), samples a pick pixel on the object's mask, back-projects it through the true heightmap, and computes the place pose so the object lands on the target pose (place = target * inv(obj_to_pick)). entries.failure_path: raises RobotSafetyViolationException / RobotConfigurationException / InvalidTrajectoryException (start not at current config, missing positions) / TrajectoryConstraintViolationException. Pitfalls: evaluate_constraint samples the path by wall-clock time while looping without sleeping, so in practice only the first few milliseconds of the trajectory are checked before n_servos iterations finish - constraint violations later in the path can pass. Execution lag only logs warnings and stops early. is_tcp_pose_reachable relies on IK returning None, but UR getInverseKinematics returns a list, so failures surface as joint-limit checks only. URrtde.forward_kinematics raises NotImplementedError.

entries.name: Ravens PickPlace execution primitive (guarded descent + suction)
entries.summary: PickPlace.__call__ moves to a pre-pick pose 32 cm above, descends in 1 mm steps until the suction tip reports contact, activates suction, lifts, checks the grasp, then descends above the place pose until contact and releases. If the grasp check fails it releases and returns to pre-pick.
